[PART ONE]
So Ted writes in Anti-Tech Revolution, Chapter 4 :
>"First, the movement must build its own internal sources of power. It
will have to create a strong, cohesive organization consisting of individu
als who are absolutely committed to the elimination of the technological
system. Numbers will be a secondary consideration. A numerically small
organization built of high-quality personnel will be far more effective than
a much larger organization in which the majority of members are of mediocre quality."

But a requirement for building a group, that is finding high quality members, is that these future members know of the TedPill. Therefore I was thinking of how to spread the Ted Pill effectively and came up with a way to TedPill entire countries within a couple of weeks. This would require approx. 10 committed TedTroopers per country, a capital of ~(see below)€ would have to be spent per person. Here is the plan (example: Germany):
